## FAQ

**What is GoHighLevel (GHL)?**
GoHighLevel is an all-in-one white-label marketing platform combining CRM, funnel builder, appointment calendar, workflow automation engine, reputation management and membership hosting. Agencies resell it under their own brand via SaaS sub-accounts.

**What does a GHL expert build for a business?**
Branded funnels, lead-response workflows (booking, texting, tagging, opportunity creation, internal notifications), opportunity pipelines and dashboards, plus reputation and re-engagement engines.

**Can AI automation replace a receptionist?**
For answering, qualifying, booking and routing — largely yes. Not for complex objections, escalations or high-value negotiation. Best practice pairs an AI voice agent with instant text-back to the human team.
